description:
## Goal

Reduce the dominant transport product population only where authoritative demand proves a position has no physical or callable obligation. Preserve position identity whenever ownership or exact dependencies differ, even when two products happen to return equal ShapeId or CallableId values.

## Current signal at a3a9761d1

One debug-interp request for `00420_enum_take_drop_split` settles:

- 4,094 TransportShape products, all distinct keys;
- 3,901 CallableConstruction products over 3,899 distinct keys;
- 9,809 products total.

These two kinds are 7,995 settlements, or 81.5 percent. The backend contains 204 executable entries and only 46 final construction wrappers. That gap is an investigation lead, not proof that the other construction products are redundant: an owner may still carry direct callable facts, layout, boundary evidence, or exact dependencies while publishing no wrapper.

The previous direction to re-key products by equal result is rejected. Equal outputs do not imply equal ownership, invalidation, or dependency identity and would violate the incremental product model.

## Preconditions

- Persistent root sessions expose cold versus retained product work.
- RuntimeDemand is reactive, so the position inventory is not distorted by whole-cone replay.
- Root relation churn is either removed or causally justified.

## Signal to add

Classify each positioned product result without formatting identity away:

- physical lanes present versus Nothing;
- callable facts present versus absent;
- construction wrapper present versus metadata-only owner versus empty owner;
- boundary obligations and direct/first-class eligibility;
- exact upstream demand fact that caused the position to be requested;
- final backend consumer that reads the answer.

Report requested keys, producer evaluations, retained cache hits, output classes, and final consumers for cold, unchanged, irrelevant-edit, and reached-edit requests.

## Output contract

- Every demanded position has an authoritative upstream obligation and a downstream consumer, or it is removed at the earliest source that can prove it unnecessary.
- Position-keyed facts remain separate when they have different owners or dependency sets.
- A provably absent physical and callable obligation does not request TransportShape or CallableConstruction downstream.
- Final packaging never scans semantic or session state to recover omitted positions.
- Persistent sessions retain unaffected positioned products across changes.
- Equal reproduction preserves generations and wakes nobody.

## Strategy

1. Measure result classes and consumer reachability after prerequisite changes.
2. Trace high-population empty or metadata-only classes back to the exact RuntimeDemand or materialization rule that requests them.
3. Strengthen that authoritative rule so impossible obligations are absent by construction.
4. Delete downstream product requests and branches made unreachable by the stronger model.
5. If every product is justified, close with the injective owner-to-consumer proof and retain the work-count ratchet.

Do not re-key by ShapeId, CallableId, rendered type, or result equality; do not add a memo around redundant requests; do not infer absence from the final wrapper count alone.

## TDD and acceptance

- Focused fixtures cover construction-present, metadata-only, direct-only, physically Nothing, and fully absent positions.
- Removed requests have zero producer evaluations and no downstream consumer.
- Retained positions name distinct ownership or dependency evidence.
- Settlement counts drop by the exactly proven removed population, or the ticket closes with a complete proportionality justification.
- Canonical BackendProgram, interp/run/build behavior, and cross-process causal traces remain identical.

## Checks and documentation

Run transport/product unit tests, target causal reports, persistent edit cases, full library, single-threaded matrix, all three execution doors, and clippy with warnings denied. Update transport, pipeline, fact-engine, performance instrumentation, and northstar; remove temporary census fields once permanent causal output covers the invariant.

## Prepared first TDD hypothesis after exact relation cutover

Fresh .57 verified take/drop trace (/tmp/fz-kdt57-artifact-baseline.Et4zBB/take-drop.verified.jsonl) has5329 TransportShape and5050 CallableConstruction settlements across sessions,10379/11340 total. Construction positions include602 executable inputs. Public product values are opaque, so these counts do NOT establish empty or removable populations.

First candidate: jobs/artifact.rs required_executable_input_transport_positions retains shape-Ignore inputs when callable_carrier_values syntactically finds them in call arguments, including scalar arguments ignored by the callee. semantic.rs RuntimeDemand::is_ignore() already checks both physical shape and callable demand, distinguishing a truly absent input from a direct-only callable with ShapeDemand::Ignore. ABI currently requests callable construction for every retained position.

First focused fixture: fn discard(_), do: 0; fn forward(x), do: discard(x); fn main(), do: forward(42). Prove forward input0 has settled fully ignored demand and no callable-flow obligation; measure exact positioned requests, then require zero producer evaluations if authoritative demand proves omission safe. Candidate collapse is the callable_carrier_values/input_indexes_for_values scanner into that existing demand authority. This remains a hypothesis, not authorization to remove metadata blindly: compiler2_unused_capture_layout_reaches_backend_wrapper proves physically absent carriers can still require lexical capture metadata and a wrapper. Audit semantic-input metadata and preserve canonical/runtime artifacts and exact ownership.

## Current TDD evidence and model

The focused ignored-forwarded-input RED proved full settled RuntimeDemand::is_ignore and no callable flow, yet one exact TransportShape(input) and one CallableConstruction(input) evaluation occurred. Removing the syntactic carrier/input-index scanners alone removed the construction request but left shape work through an ignored CallArg recipe alias. Returning bottom from a fully ignored shape demand before following recipe aliases makes this regression GREEN.

The lexical-capture guardrail then exposed real metadata coupling: an ignored captured parameter had incidentally supplied value_layouts through the dead input. Required local Value positions now include exact RuntimeDemand.callable_flows captures as well as producer values. This preserves wrapper lexical capture metadata at its real value owner, not through an unused ExecutableInput; the existing guardrail is GREEN. Do not replace this with a backend fallback or scan.

A typed ABI-owner census after the scanner change classifies take/drop retained owners as38construction-present physical,427metadata-only (125absent/302physical), and4496empty (233absent/4263physical). These classify immutable owner.construction/callable_facts/boundary_facts and exact ABI product dependencies; they are not yet the final removed population. Scalar RED identifies two empty generic owners (main Value and return) with no callable obligation.

Candidate generic-owner omission must follow actual producer selection: retain all local CallableValue+callable_flow producers, including direct-only and physically absent metadata cases. For generic positions retain the exact positioned shape read, and omit construction requests only where the existing generic production cannot emit callable evidence (no structural Callable node). Reuse the existing structural predicate and producer selector rather than parallel scanners. Audit traversal-only dependencies before treating empty output as unnecessary work. Nothing-shaped endpoints/lexical captures can remain necessary zero-lane shape contracts; fully ignored ExecutableInput is a distinct absence proof.

Independent audit maps construction/metadata/direct-only/Nothing/fully-absent classes to existing preserving tests. RuntimeDemand::is_ignore checks both axes; TransportCarrier::Absent is not ShapeDescr::Nothing; nested callable tuple demand and lexical capture ordering remain authoritative. ReturnPayload type/demand divergence is separately tracked fz-tfn.42 and must not be silently folded into this ticket. Generic omission can avoid that discrepant helper.

Current .58 changes are uncommitted; final census, canonical/runtime parity, retained edit tests, cold review and full gates still required. Unrelated untracked historical measurement/recovery files in .agent/measurements are preserved and excluded from this ticket.

## Broader omission RED/GREEN

The independent audit confirmed non-Callable structural trees make generic owner projection empty by exhaustive branches; traversed source evidence is discarded. Root reachability/packaging consumes ABI-owned answers, not arbitrary memo entries, and reached ABIs independently retain local callable-flow producers. Preserve the exact shape edge and local producer path; recursive scheduling remains a verification obligation.

The implemented candidate shares the local CallableValue+RuntimeDemand.flow selector between producer and ABI; generic owners are requested only when the exact structural shape contains a Callable node. Existing native shape_contains_callable moved to the transport interner/World rather than duplicating recursion. The obsolete seven-list ABI-owner iterator is removed in favor of already ordered exact position_layouts, retaining ownership filtering and shape dependencies.

Focused census is GREEN: take/drop4496emptyowners->0 while38construction and427metadata owners remain; scalar2emptyowners->0. This is not yet full delivery proof. Retained scenario coverage, permanent cheap class reporting on existing events, docs, broader regression/recursion tests, canonical parity and final cold review remain to finish. No new per-owner event/counter or runtime classification store is justified.

comments.text: fz-kdt.208 (filed from the fz-kdt.179 build, 2026-09-03) is a concrete instance of this ticket`s "prune unnecessary callable-construction products": a construction wrapper keeps the executable and boundary of a member the dispatch drop removed. Native DCEs it; interp/canon keep it. Linking as related.

title: Prove and prune unnecessary transport-shape and callable-construction products
